objective: Learn how and when to perform safe overtaking manoeuvres.

missions.title: KNOW YOUR ROAD
missions.description: Identify road markings and restrictions before attempting an overtake.

trafficRule.title: Observe Road Markings
trafficRule.description: Dashed center lines permit overtaking when clear. Solid center lines strictly prohibit overtaking.

missions.title: FIND THE SAFE GAP
missions.description: Assess oncoming traffic speed and distance. Wait for tight gaps to clear, then pass during safe gaps.

trafficRule.title: Judge Oncoming Traffic
trafficRule.description: Only overtake when the oncoming lane has enough clear distance to complete the pass safely.

missions.title: KNOW WHEN NOT TO OVERTAKE
missions.description: Hold safe following distance behind traffic on blind bends and crossings without overtaking.

trafficRule.title: Hazardous Zones
trafficRule.description: Never overtake on blind bends, hill crests, pedestrian crossings, or intersections.

missions.title: COMPLETE THE OVERTAKE
missions.description: Execute the full 7-step safe sequence: Distance -> Signal Left -> Pass -> Clearance -> Signal Right -> Return.

trafficRule.title: The Safe Overtake Sequence
trafficRule.description: Always signal before moving out and before returning, and allow adequate clearance before re-entering.

missions.title: THE OVERTAKING TEST
missions.description: Apply all skills in a continuous driving challenge: decide when to wait and when to pass safely.

trafficRule.title: Master of Safe Overtaking
trafficRule.description: Sound judgement, patience, and correct signaling are the hallmarks of a safe driver.
